scenario.title: S1 · A badly sited IoT sensor quietly lowers the malaria forecast
scenario.summary: Built from a real finding of the thesis (sensor_validation): the first deployed LoRa/Meshtastic node in Yaoundé reads +7.27 °C and -30.6 RH points against the ERA5 reanalysis the models were trained on, at an identical dew point. The element is sound; the siting is not. Fed raw, the sensor lowers the forecast. Nobody has the full picture: the surveillance unit sees the data, the telecom regulator sees the network, the ministry sees the field, and a regional delegation acts on the dashboard.

steps.title: First IoT capture disagrees with the reanalysis

event.text: Node !a0cb4a5c (Biyem Assi health district, Yaoundé) reports for April 2026: temperature 30.73 °C, relative humidity 56.8 %, pressure 927.90 hPa. ERA5 for the same hours: 23.46 °C, 87.4 %, 923.63 hPa.
Gateway logs: node !a0cb4a5c changed position on 28 March and now relays through a new rooftop repeater; 12 % packet loss on the 868 MHz link.
Biyem Assi district health team: RDT positivity this April is similar to last April; ACT stocks are adequate.
